decision.next_hypothesis: Move the retained lifecycle snapshot before FIFO enqueue, then repeat the unchanged batch-8 measurement to recover valid queue, formation, response and cadence tails.

hypothesis.prediction: A position-aware FIFO can combine eight independent layer-89 decode streams exactly, retain >=1.7x aggregate device capacity, preserve fairness, and cancel/reuse one slot without state interference.

implementation.formation: oldest ready rows, up to certified batch 8
implementation.positions: one validated cache position per row
implementation.scheduler: bounded in-process FIFO, no threads or async tasks
implementation.state: one persistent CUDA-owned session per active stream

inspection.actual_bottleneck: Complete-stage CUDA service dominates normal rounds. The 79.5988 ms queue outlier is benchmark instrumentation: the first retained lifecycle snapshot ran after enqueue and before dispatch, so queue/formation/response p99 are invalid in this receipt.
inspection.fixture_limitation: Eight streams use the three retained real layer boundaries with different state positions; physical request-arrival jitter is not replayed. Device timing, exactness, state, routing, fairness, lifecycle and cancellation evidence are valid; queue/formation/response/cadence tails require the H014-031b rerun.
